title: VOL 9 — Test 3 (Reading + Listening)
description: Đề lẻ, chỉ có Reading và Listening — không có Writing và Speaking nên không thi thử full được. Chọn một trong hai kỹ năng để làm. Cả hai đều chấm ngay theo đáp án và ra band luôn. Phần Listening dùng một file ghi âm liền cho cả bốn phần.

parts.title: SECTION 1
parts.body:
SECTION 1
Read the text and answer questions 1–10
Questions 1–8
Choose the correct answer.
Example
The man wants to visit the centre with
a friends
relative
colleagues
1 The centre has enough accommodation for
18 people.
20 people.
38 people.
2 The meeting room is currently
unavailable.
flooded.
booked.
3 Visitors must tell the centre in advance if they want to
use the centre’s kitchen.
have meals cooked for them.
eat at restaurants outside.
4 All visitors on the of the farm can
get information about organic farming.
help to feed the animals.
watch a tractor demonstration.
5 On the survival course, people have to
learn to use map.
find their own food.
run through woodland.
6 From the centre, it is easy to walk to
Exmoor National Park.
the beach.
a cycling rout.
7 If the weather is bad visitors can go to a
cinema.
theatre.
museum.
8 Groups who wish to stay at the centre must pay
part of the cost in advance.
all of the cost in advance.
all of the cost on arrival.

parts.title: SECTION 3
parts.body:
SECTION 3
Read the text and answer questions 21–30
Questions 21–26
Choose the correct answer.
Voice training for drama students
21 Ed is giving the voice coaching workshop in order to get
a new job.
a qualification.
a promotion.
22 According to Fiona, the seating pattern that Ed chooses
should be illustrated visually.
has to be explained in detail.
is not particularly important.
23 Fiona and Ed agree that in the first activity, the students
may feel uncomfortable.
like to make group contact.
must focus on themselves.
24 Fiona and Ed agree that in the second activity, Ed should
insist which students work together.
tell students to prepare a speech.
include a focus on breath control.
25 What does Fiona suggest about working in a big space?
It could be outside or inside.
It is best to go to somewhere like a park.
It is useful for getting actors to shout.
26 What does Fiona think of Ed's selection of texts?
It should include more classical texts.
It needs to focus on a single emotion.
It has to cover a wider range.
Questions 27–30
What disadvantage do the speakers identify for each of the following textbooks?
Choose FOUR correct answers, A-G, next to questions 27-30.
Disadvantages
A too expensive
B too limited
C prejudiced
D unrealistic
E out of date
F too detailed
G unavailable
Textbooks
Vocal Instruction 27____________
Improve Your Accent 28___________
Actors' Handbook 29___________
Confident Voice Delivery 30___________

SECTION 4
Read the text and answer questions 31–40
Questions 31–40
Complete the notes below.
Write ONE WORD ONLY for each answer.
Food Safety Standards
Risk assessment
Scientists have to consider potential problems with:
• the product's 31___________ (could they attract harmful bacteria?)
• method of preparation (will it eliminate harmful micro-organisms?)
• how products are 32___________and distributed
• supermarkets (e.g. changes in 33___________ affecting the condition of frozen food
• end-users (how is food usually handled in the home?)
Factors affecting food consumption
Legislation
Consumer attitudes
• e.g. dislike of additives → growth of the 34___________ food market in Australia
The food industry
• supermarkets may use price or 35___________ as their selling strategy (but the main concern is profitability)
The mass media
• now the main source of 36___________for many
• negative effect because not objective:
concern for 37___________
news is now a form of 38___________ which can mislead the public
• few programmes deal with food safety or 39___________
Personal opinion
Importance of education: as with benefits of exercise, many children can influence their 40___________
